tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1997 年发布
description: 美能达于1997年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度30s-1/8000s, B.。使用6-6400 ISO/ASA. Automatic setting for DX-coded film from ISO 25 to 6400.。TTL phase detection, EV -1 to 19 (ISO 100), 4 AF zones, (AF-A), continuous (AF-C), single-shot (AF-A)。

specs.卡口: Minolta AF baynoet mount (Maxxum/Dynax lenses, non-compatible with earlier SR)
specs.快门: vertical focal-plane shutter, electronically controlled, metal
specs.闪光灯: Variable GN 14-20, auto zooming equivalent 24mm - 80 mm focal length coverage.
specs.曝光测光: 14-segment honeycomb pattern SPC for ambient light and flash-metering SPC for flash, centre-weighted and spot metering.
specs.胶片/画幅: 6-6400 ISO/ASA. Automatic setting for DX-coded film from ISO 25 to 6400.
specs.对焦: TTL phase detection, EV -1 to 19 (ISO 100), 4 AF zones, (AF-A), continuous (AF-C), single-shot (AF-A)
specs.取景器: Eye-level fixed pentaprism High-Eyepoint approx. 22,9mm from eyepiece with 92% x 94% field of view.
specs.重量: 628g (without battery) 640g (with Quartz Data Back, without battery).
